test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To be in two minds

options.text: To be dominated by someone else
To work on somebody else's advice
To be in a critical state

solution:
The correct answer is "**To be uncertain.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"to be in two minds" means to be unsure or undecided about something**.

 
 
• Example: I was in two minds whether or not to come this evening.
